concerns.text: The scaling factor *s* is fitted on the full benchmark set (train + test) and then the same *s* is applied to the entire dataset before the bulk‑property correlation (Phase 5). Because *s* is derived from the same observations that are later used to assess correlation with density/viscosity, the correlation results may be optimistically biased. A more rigorous approach would reserve a completely held‑out subset (or use only the test split) for any downstream analysis that involves the scaled D3 term, or employ nested cross‑validation so that the parameter fitting and correlation assessment are performed on independent data.
